To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the dielectric properties of nanocomposites based on ferroelectric SC (NH2) 2 and porous alumina films are studied.
dielectric permittivity of nanoporous alumina films filled with ferroelectric SC (NH2)2 is substantially enhanced in the temperature ranges of ferroelectric and incommensurate phases.
the dielectric properties and phase transition temperatures of SC(NH2)(2)/porous Al2O3 nanocomposites strongly depend on the pore size of the alumina matrix.
In summary, our research is concerned with
dielectric properties of nanocomposites based on nanoporous alumina and ferroelectric SC (NH2)2.
the dielectric properties of nanocomposites consisting of ferroelectric SC (NH2)2 embedded in nanoporous alumina films.
a study of dielectric properties of nanocomposite films based on nanoporous alumina and ferroelectric SC (NH2)2.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dielectric and ferroelectric properties of nanocomposite are significantly influenced by the pore sizes of nanoporous alumina.
the ferroelectric phase transitions of SC(NH2)(2) embedded in the pores of nanoporous alumina films are suppressed, and the suppression is more pronounced as pore sizes decrease.
the phase transition temperature is shifted to a higher temperature when the pores of the matrix are smaller.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the phase transitions are suppressed in nanocomposites.
the phase transitions are suppressed in the nanoporous alumina films with ferroelectric SC (NH2)2 filling.
the dielectric properties and phase transition temperatures of ferroelectrics in porous films depend on the pore diameters.
The main takeaway from our work is that
nanoporous alumina films can serve as a template for embedding ferroelectrics and for the study of the effect of the pore size and pore shape on the properties of the embedded ferroelectrics.
the dielectric properties of ferroelectric SC (NH2)2 can be tuned by varying the size of the pore in the nanoporous alumina matrix.
the dielectric response of nanocomposites can be tailored by varying the pore sizes of alumina films.
